en.text: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

footnotes.text: 130:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我從深處向你求告！

en.text: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你听我的声音！ 愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音！

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你聽我的聲音！ 願你側耳聽我懇求的聲音！

en.text: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

zhSimplified.text: 主—耶和华啊，你若究察罪孽， 谁能站得住呢？

zhTraditional.text: 主－耶和華啊，你若究察罪孽， 誰能站得住呢？

en.text: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

zhSimplified.text: 但在你有赦免之恩， 要叫人敬畏你。

zhTraditional.text: 但在你有赦免之恩， 要叫人敬畏你。

en.text: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

zhSimplified.text: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候； 我也仰望他的话。

zhTraditional.text: 我等候耶和華，我的心等候； 我也仰望他的話。

en.text: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心等候主， 胜于守夜的，等候天亮， 胜于守夜的，等候天亮。

zhTraditional.text: 我的心等候主， 勝於守夜的，等候天亮， 勝於守夜的，等候天亮。

en.text: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华！ 因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華！ 因他有慈愛，有豐盛的救恩。

en.text: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

zhSimplified.text: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。

zhTraditional.text: 他必救贖以色列脫離一切的罪孽。
